name: manticore
_about: SCULPTED (2026-11-05, docs/engines.md 'the sculpt overlay'): a lion's body -- the lion's own rig and shapes (mammals/lion.json) scaled from its .95 to .9 -- in cinnabar red, the mane in the lion's fleece, darker; a dragon's bat wings at the withers (dragons.js dragonBatWing, as rig parts: four finger bones drawn by the body, the membranes authored: each wedge of skin a plate on its own bone, darker at its edge), folded up and back over the rump at rest and spread aloft by flyRot; and for a tail a scorpion's, on a path of tubes from the croup arching up and forward over the hindquarters (clear of a rider), drawn as seven glossy knobbed segments, the bulbous vesicle and the aculeus curving forward and down (2026-11-08, ears2.py) The EARS (ears2.py): round cupped sheets (sharp.js `fin`), dark edged, cream in the hollow; the roots faired.
